## 1. Expansion thesis

This plan expands attention around five people meeting beside a radish in place of chairs while leaving the journal row intact. It offers different distances and registers for rereading the same recorded material; it does not add a new day, memory, event, relationship, quest, or system.

## 2. Story question

What does a chapel become when familiar chairs and a table are no longer the only place people can meet?

## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_56_priest_the_outdoor_chapel",
  "text": "The chapel went outside. Day 265. The Teacher began the outdoor classroom in zone 1 and the chapel went outside. I did not plan it. The Exhausted Father asked if the chapel could meet on the surface. I said I did not know. I said the chapel is 6 chairs and a table. He said the surface does not need chairs and a table. He said the surface is the chapel. I said the surface is the chapel. The surface is the thing that does not need the chairs and the table because the surface is the thing that holds. The surface holds the radish. The surface holds the moss. The surface holds the water. The surface holds us. The surface is the chapel. We met on the surface on Day 267. 5 people: the Widow, the Exhausted Father, the Historian, the Child Soldier, the Bouncer. The Bouncer came for the first time. He sat at the edge. He said he is the watcher and the watching is the praying. I said the watching is the praying. He sat. I said the words I remember. I said them on the surface. The surface is the thing that does not need the words to be correct. The surface is the thing that needs the words to be said. I said the words. The surface held them. The surface held us. The surface is the chapel. The chapel is the surface. The spring is the thing that made the chapel go outside. The spring is the thing that made the bunker go outside. The bunker is going outside. The bunker is a place. A place goes outside. A bunker stays inside. The bunker is a place. The chapel is outside. The words are outside. The spring is outside. The spring is the thing that is outside. The outside is the thing the spring made.",
  "timestamp": "Day 267, 19h",
  "author_name": "The Priest",
  "author_id": "the_priest",
  "knowledge_key": "priest_outdoor_chapel_surface",
  "day": 267,
  "hour": 19.0
}
```
